newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsui Petchem, Mitsui Toatsu shares suspended - TSE.
newsitem.headline: Mitsui Petchem, Mitsui Toatsu shares suspended - TSE.

text.p: Trade in shares of Mitsui Petrochemical Industries Ltd and Mitsui Toatsu Chemicals Inc was suspended for the entire day on Monday, the Tokyo Stock Exchange said.
The exchange said it was suspending trade due to uncertainties over the companies' plans to merge.

Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported on Monday that Mitsui Petrochemical and Mitsui Toatsu had agreed to merge in October 1997 to form the second-largest petrochemical company in Japan.
Both Mitsui Petrochemical and Mitsui Toatsu spokesmen declined to comment on the report.
The paper said Mitsui Toatsu would be dissolved on the merger. It said 0.5 to 0.6 Mitsui Petrochemical shares would be exchanged for one Mitsui Toatsu share.
